QUOTE_"_CHARACTER - Static variable in class p.Widget
A double quote in a symbol must be escaped in the Emacs Lisp output.
BACKSLASH_\_CHARACTER - Static variable in class p.Widget
A backslash in a symbol must be escaped in the Emacs Lisp output. The goal file records that CreateJavadocIndex does not escape it, which makes Emacs read the symbol as "BACKSLASH__CHARACTER".
